description.text: The majorVeterinary Medicineof Zhejiang A&F University is a national grade first-class undergraduate major and one of the seven majors in Zhejiang Province with contracted graduates exclusively serving in the field of Agriculture. The major ofVeterinary Medicinethrives on the Discipline ofVeterinary Medicinewhich is provincially graded as first class. The majorVeterinary Medicinehas 60 doctorated faculty members. There are 22 licensed veterinarians including 2 DVMsgraduated from the U.S.-China DVM scholarship program. Our practical teaching platforms include the Key Laboratory of Applied Technology on Green-Eco-Healthy Animal Husbandry of Zhejiang Province, theVeterinary Medicineand Health Management International Science and Technology Cooperation Base of Zhejiang Province, Veterinary Diagnostic Center, the first veterinary laboratory accredited by the China National Accreditation Service (ISO/IEC 17025) for Conformity Assessment and China Metrology Accreditation, ZAFU Veterinary Teaching Hospital. Gold courses are neatly built incorporating National Virtual Reality (VR) Teaching Projects. Our goal is to cultivate talents with a skill set of problem solving and a mindset of "One world, One health" for the veterinary profession.According to the national quality standards, level 3 accreditation requirement for the major ofVeterinary Medicine, requirements for development of Emerging Agricultural Education, ethnicity-oriented education, more intimately intertwined general education and professional education, establishment of morefirst-classcourses, development of a global vision of the students, more social engagement into education, the curricula ofVeterinary Medicineare designed.The 70 points pass system (100-point system) is adopted for all the courses in this training program. The students who have scored less than 70 points will be regarded as fail, and the students who have scored less than 77 points inanacademic year will bestayeddown.Our mission is to produce qualified veterinarians with strong moral characters, high intelligence, a sturdy physique, elegancy, diligence and a mindset of “One World, One Health”. Graduates are expected to actively involve in the animal industries, including but not limited to animal production, animal health, veterinary medicine, public health, wild life reservation, food safety and security andetc..Thestudents are trained on diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of animal diseases, animal hygiene inspection, the safety of animal products, the prevention and control of zoonotic diseases, and the overall protection of animal and human health with their professional skillsets, inventiveness, entrepreneurship and a global vision.

duration.text: The Veterinary Medicine at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: For the students who have never studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Language proficiency certificate4.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.5.Other certificates or documents 6.Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months7.Application Form For School8.Family Information Form9.Financial Income Statement10.A Short Video of Self Introduction11.Commitment without Drug Use History 12.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）For the transferred students who have already studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa page2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Last semester transcript in the previous school4.Language proficiency certificate5.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.6.Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance 7.certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months8.Application Form For School9.Family Information Form10. Financial Income Statement11.A Short Video of Self Introduction12.Commitment without Drug Use History 13.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be aged between 18 and 282.Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid regular foreign passport and be friendly to China; *Residents of China who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years. (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).
